title: France name_tokens: city and place-name coverage
scope: all three test sources jointly; denominator by_country.France.rows
headline: The France name_tokens axis contains zero place names in its top 30 (legal-form and organisational vocabulary); the highest city bordeaux is rank 41. Places are only visible on addr_tokens (ranks 8-30). Top-10 place tokens carry 1,443,294 occurrences = 85.17 per 100 French rows, an upper bound on rows.

answers.a_top30_places_on_name_axis: IMPOSSIBLE - the top 30 of name_tokens contains 0 place names; premise is wrong about the axis
answers.a_correct_axis: addr_tokens, where the 10 named places occupy ranks 8-30
answers.b_top10_concentration: 1443294 occurrences / 1694445 rows = 85.17 per 100 rows; token-occurrence sum, UPPER BOUND on rows, not a row count
answers.c_separability: clean on addr_tokens (disjoint rank bands vs rue/avenue), not on name_tokens
answers.blocking: city should NOT be a blocking key and structurally CANNOT be one - keys.py emits address tokens only inside conjunctive kind-0/kind-2 keys, never bare

top10_places.measure: token occurrences, upper bound on rows; multi-word communes double-count
